name: album-folders
description: The albums as folders of real files on disk, for browsing outside EiN

options.label: Album folders location
options.description: Where the albums are kept as folders of files, as the EiN server sees it. Empty means the folder albums beside the stored files. It must be on the same mount as the stored files, since each file there is a hard link to one of them.

options.label: Album folders full check (seconds)
options.description: How often every album folder is compared with its album, beside following each change as it happens. This catches what a change notice missed.
